objectives.description: Restrict the --fix anchor search to known metadata_fields names (bullet or bare form) instead of any bold bullet
Replace the sed -i insertion with an awk rewrite to a temp file + mv, passing missing-field text via stdin/getline rather than interpolating artifact content into sed

Fix a latent set-e/pipefail abort in the anchor-search assignment on the no-match path (discovered during Phase 4 verification, not in original plan text; required by the plan's own no-anchor-case test)

deviations.description: Plan's Phase 4 tasks list four bullets covering anchor restriction and the awk rewrite; it did not anticipate the no-match path having its own independent set -e/pipefail abort (a different latent bug in the same block, only surfaced by actually running the plan's own 'no-anchor case' verification).
deviations.reason: Fixing only the four listed tasks left the plan's own required no-anchor-case verification failing (script aborted silently with no [WARN] or terminal line before this fix). Added a one-line `|| true` guard to the anchor assignment so the existing 'Cannot auto-fix' warn branch is reachable again, matching the plan's stated intent (preserve that branch) rather than widening scope.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added a `|| true` guard on the anchor-search assignment to fix a second, independently-discovered set -e/pipefail abort on the no-match path, required to satisfy the plan's own no-anchor-case verification)*
